Bug_Title: IJU: JUnit assertion in run method will not be noticed by JUnit (IJU_ASSERT_METHOD_INVOKED_FROM_RUN_METHOD)
Bug_Details:
A JUnit assertion is performed in a run method. Failed JUnit assertions
just result in exceptions being thrown.
Thus, if this exception occurs in a thread other than the thread that invokes
the test method, the exception will terminate the thread but not result
in the test failing.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the Runnable class, where the assert false statement is not noticed by JUnit because it is being executed in a separate thread.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case is triggered by the showBug() method in the JUnitAssertionInRunMethod class. When the test case is executed, the assert false statement in the run() method of the Runnable object is executed, resulting in an AssertionError being thrown. This error is not caught by the JUnit test case, so the test case fails. This failure triggers the bug in the JUnitAssertionInRunMethod class.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results show that the assertion in the run method is not noticed by JUnit, and the test passes without failing. This confirms the bug is triggered.
